rule: FOUR LIVING FILES plus the argument. NOTEBOOK (append-forward) · MEASURES (measurements only) · PREREG (frozen) · MANY-AND-ONE (the architecture) · DIVISION-OF-GOD (§I, standalone). Superseded drafts retained, marked, not cited.

structure.EA-NOTEBOOK-01.md: LIVING — read forward. Fifteen rounds plus the standing frame. Append new rounds at the END; do not reorganise.
structure.EA-AUTHORSHIP-MEASURES-01.md: LIVING REGISTER — MEASUREMENTS ONLY, with their conditions and refutations. §0A is the entryway (M40). ⚠ Source criticism, reception history and attestation audits belong in the NOTEBOOK, not here — this was got wrong twice (M49→Round 40, M52→Round 42).
structure.PREREG-LEDGER.md: FROZEN, APPEND-ONLY. Six registrations with their original SHA-256s and their dispositions. Nothing above a DISPOSITION line is ever edited. New tests append a new ENTRY at the end.
structure.data/: supporting extractions — snub loci, base-rate table, argument map
structure.PAPER-ARCHITECTURE.md: STRUCTURAL — the six stations and why they are in that order. Not a draft; the argument shape the notebook and register feed. Read after §0A, before writing anything.
structure.MANY-AND-ONE-MAXIMAL.md: THE ARGUMENT — the thesis stated at full strength and grounded in the close reading: the designed incompletion (Sappho/Longinus/Catullus), the authorial economy, the corpus’s own vocabulary of fragmenting/minting/legitimacy/unification, M40, the seal-and-wax machine, the field counted as extant originals only. Draft 2026-08-30. NOT a replacement for PAPER-ARCHITECTURE (six stations, twelve positions) — that is the delivery structure; this is what it delivers.
structure.EA-MANY-AND-ONE.md: THE ARCHITECTURE — eight sections descending from Λ 9 to the corpus. God, life, kind, collection, the divided person, the many voices, the insufficiency of hulē, the order of the corpus. Supersedes PAPER-ARCHITECTURE.
structure.EA-DIVISION-OF-GOD.md: §I of MANY AND ONE, and publishable standalone. APr I.31 diagnoses division’s failure to select; Λ 9 puts divine nous through the same branching form, selects, and grounds the identity in immateriality, closing at ἀδιαίρετον.
structure.EA-DIVISION-OF-LIFE.md: §II of MANY AND ONE. De an. 413b: one in actuality, many in potentiality — the theorem one level below Λ, where matter is present and the unity survives real division.
structure.EA-MANY-ACCOUNTS.md: §III of MANY AND ONE. Sophist 231d–232b: six true divisions of one kind, and the many names diagnosed as a defect in the beholder — he cannot discern what all the learnings look toward, so he uses many names instead of one.
structure.EA-DIVIDED-PERSON.md: §V of MANY AND ONE, and the seam. Statesman 257d–258a: the corpus divides its founder into face and name and keeps neither as the criterion — kin are recognised dia logon. With Cat. 1a1 on homonyms, Rep. 395b’s kermatismos as the objection, and GC 315b as the reply.
structure.EA-COLLECTION.md: §IV of MANY AND ONE, last of the theorems. Phdr. 249c ek pollon eis hen; the two hoion-syllogismos classifications; De mem. 451a–453a — recollection is not memory, search succeeds where it fails, and remembering is presence dynamei. Records the order-of-grasp as a possibility for §VIII to earn.
structure.EA-MANY-VOICES.md: §VI of MANY AND ONE. Plato withholds the rule and Aristotle supplies it; the ladder as the track, with the second rung being unity recognised across plurality; SE 183b7 as one maker at two grasps; and the λόγος-level identity licensed by Phdr. 276a, with the historical claim protected.

why_prereg_cannot_merge: A pre-registration is worth something only because its content was fixed before the test ran. A hash over an appending notebook proves nothing. The ledger keeps them frozen while stopping them proliferating at three files apiece.

EA-MANY-AND-ONE supersedes PAPER-ARCHITECTURE. The argument stops building toward the claim and starts descending from it, with the harrowing placed second-to-last: the logos-level operation is established six times over, THEN the matter is measured and found insufficient — which is the boundary Λ 1075a1 states before any measurement is taken.

known_failure_mode: append by anchor-replace is UNSAFE when the anchor appears more than once — str.replace on the closing sigil duplicated sections 17-22 of the register and truncated section 5. Append by unique section anchor instead.

ledger_entries.prediction: independently puzzling or independently measured structures become MORE DETERMINATE under the one-construction reading, without altering local philology
targets_frozen: T-E Theaetetus 209c argument structure searched independently of sim-
T-F the four Platonic naming-gap works
ledger_entries.kill: fewer than 3 unlocks in 6 fails; 2+ failures damages H_H at maximum; any mid-run weakening voids
ledger_entries.reverse_engineering_rule: an UNLOCK counts only if the target was pre-frozen AND the resolving passage was not found by searching until something fit

ledger_entries.purpose: a relational-form measure with NO Greek content, so control pairs are not tested for membership in the configuration
forms: R3 arbitrary procedural agreement, independent works only
ledger_entries.classes: H one-person-multiple-positions, S master-student, C collaboration, I independent, O single-author
ledger_entries.admissibility: S class requires attestation with no relation to textual style, doctrine, or the succession tradition under test — Thomas passes, Theophrastus does not
ledger_entries.contamination_rule: commentary works inadmissible for R3 (shared source); independent works are the clean test
ledger_entries.kill: if the measure cannot separate H from S out-of-sample, it has failed and says nothing about Plato — fires BEFORE the target is scored

ledger_entries.hypothesis: container tightness tracks SPECIFICATION DEPTH — the severity of the constraint on a position, not similarity or disguise
ledger_entries.prediction: Platonic SPEAKER tightness orders by constraint severity; Socrates, the least constrained, sits nearest 1.0
ledger_entries.kill: uncorrelated ordering fails it; Socrates not among the loosest fails it; the constraint ranking may not be revised after measurement
ledger_entries.does_not_buy: nothing about authorship — a dramatist specifying characters to differing depths produces the same gradient; this measures construction, which dramatic and heteronymic composition share

ledger_entries.why: M46 chose its term sets after seeing each corpus; this fixes a mechanical selection rule that cannot see the interpreted position
ledger_entries.rule: term set = 30 content words most distinctive of the INTERPRETER against a language reference corpus, computed without reference to the interpreted position; capture score = median rate ratio, with zero-count reported
ledger_entries.kill: if S2 scores within the H range the measure is not diagnostic and M46 is withdrawn as evidence — the condition most likely to fire

ledger_entries.operator: Matthean fulfillment — a later text claims an earlier was about it, the earlier was not making that claim, and the relation works by structural correspondence

parameters.C: material closeness (Catullus 51 is the calibration standard)

ledger_entries.singleton_problem: if genuinely singular, frequency inference is unavailable; the registration commits to a FIT test (probability of this configuration with no relation) and abandons the frequency form
ledger_entries.ceiling: establishes RELATION not AUTHORSHIP — Catullus is non-randomly related to Sappho and is not Sappho
ledger_entries.kill: if C cannot score Catullus/Sappho high and arbitrary same-genre pairs low, no construct validity; if the whole-apparatus scope claim rests on the six slots it is circular
